texts.orig: Table 3-19 provides a summary of the controls and control enhancements assigned to the System and Information Integrity Family. The controls are allocated to the low-impact, moderate-impact, and high-impact security control baselines and the privacy control baseline, as appropriate. A control or control enhancement that has been withdrawn from the control catalog is indicated by a "W" and an explanation of the control or control enhancement disposition in light gray text.
